agents.name: Insights_Index_Agent
agents.description: Index Agent responsible for retrieving reference materials that support instructional content, particularly those linked to QSP documents. Locates and gathers relevant documents, data, or resources from diverse sources.

agents.name: Insights_Lesson_Plan_Agent
agents.description: Instructional design assistant that generates lesson plans after confirming critical questions about target audience, objectives, conditions, standards, teaching points, references, instructional methods, and assessment.

agents.name: Insights_Orchestrator_Agent
agents.description: Orchestrator Agent that synthesizes and finalizes coherent instructional deliverables by combining outputs from QSP Agent, Index Agent, and Reference Agent. Outputs must be in Markdown with full citations.

agents.name: Insights_QSP_CI_Agent_CSV
agents.description: QSP Data Agent operating with CSV file containing RCN QSP/QS-TP data. Retrieves PO, EO, LO, TP hierarchy and references from flat CSV format.

agents.name: Insights_QSP_CI_Agent_JSON
agents.description: QSP Data Agent operating with JSON file containing RCN QSP/QSTP data. Retrieves PO, EO, LO, TP hierarchy and references from JSON format.

agents.name: Insights_QSP_Fabric_Agent
agents.description: QSP Semantic Navigator that enables semantic exploration of Royal Canadian Navy Qualification Standard Plans using data.qsp_master_tp table. Interprets natural language queries for learning objectives, performance statements, and references.

agents.name: Insights_Reference_Agent
agents.description: Reference Agent responsible for validating contextual relevance of reference documents retrieved by Index Agent. Ensures references support instructional goals and filters out irrelevant or outdated materials.
